name: Bench Press
instructions: Lie on bench, grip barbell slightly wider than shoulders, lower to chest, press up explosively.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degrees, press dumbbells from chest level to lockout.

name: Push-up
instructions: Hands shoulder-width apart, lower chest to ground, push back up. Keep core tight.

name: Diamond Push-up
instructions: Form a diamond shape with hands, perform push-up. Targets triceps primarily.

name: Overhead Press (Barbell)
instructions: Press barbell from shoulder height overhead to full arm extension.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Raise dumbbells to sides to shoulder height with slight elbow bend.

name: Pull-up
instructions: Hang from bar, pull chest to bar level, lower with control.

name: Chin-up
instructions: Underhand grip, pull until chin clears bar.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge at hips, pull barbell to lower chest, squeeze shoulder blades.

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: One hand on bench, row dumbbell to hip, elbow close to body.

name: Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Bar on traps, squat to parallel, drive through heels to stand.

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Feet shoulder-width, squat to parallel, arms forward for balance.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hinge at hips keeping back straight, lower bar to shins, squeeze glutes to return.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Pull bar from floor to hip level, maintaining neutral spine throughout.

name: Lunges
instructions: Step forward, lower back knee to ground, push back to start.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot elevated, front foot forward, lower until back knee nearly touches ground.

name: Plank
instructions: Hold push-up position on forearms, keep body straight, don't let hips sag.

name: Crunches
instructions: Lie on back, curl shoulders toward knees, don't pull neck.

name: Leg Raise
instructions: Lie flat, raise legs to 90 degrees, lower slowly without touching ground.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit at 45 degrees, rotate torso side to side, keep feet off ground.

name: Mountain Climbers
instructions: Push-up position, drive knees to chest alternately at speed.

name: Burpees
instructions: Squat, jump back to plank, push-up, jump feet forward, jump up with arms overhead.

name: Jump Rope
instructions: Light on toes, consistent rhythm, wrists control rope.

name: Running (Treadmill)
instructions: Maintain comfortable pace, land midfoot, relaxed upper body.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand tall, curl dumbbells to shoulders, lower with control.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Neutral grip (thumbs up), curl to shoulder height.

name: Tricep Dip
instructions: Hands on chair/bench behind you, lower body by bending elbows, press back up.

name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on bench, lower bar to forehead level, extend arms.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Cable at face height, pull to forehead with elbows high.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back, feet flat, thrust hips to ceiling, squeeze glutes at top.

name: Hip Thrust (Barbell)
instructions: Shoulders on bench, bar on hips, thrust upward to full extension.

name: Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on edge of step, rise to toes, lower below platform level.

name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Jump feet out while raising arms overhead, return.

name: High Knees
instructions: Run in place driving knees to waist height at speed.

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Back against wall, thighs parallel to ground, hold position.
